# vibeoncall_chat_channel (Data Source)

Looks up a channel by name on the Slack workspace or Microsoft Teams tenant the organization is connected to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vibeoncall_chat_channel" "incidents" {
  name = "incidents"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Channel name, without `#`. Matched exactly, ignoring case.

### Optional

- `microsoft_teams_team_id` (String) ID of the Microsoft Teams team the channel belongs to: the `groupId` in the team's link. Required on Microsoft Teams, rejected on Slack.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Platform channel ID, referenced by maintenance window announcement channels and escalation policy channel targets.
